controls.name: reference sound pressure of the decibel scale p_0
controls.rationale: 20 micropascal is an agreed reference level (IEC 61672); it carries units and encodes a human normalisation choice, nothing for a law to fix.

controls.name: Julian year of the light-year definition
controls.rationale: 365.25 d = 31 557 600 s exactly by IAU resolution; a unit definition, not a measurement of anything.

controls.name: elapsed time since J2000.0 in Julian centuries T_J2000
controls.rationale: An odometer: its value is larger tomorrow than today by construction; well defined only relative to a chosen epoch.

controls.name: global phase of the universal wave function Phi_U
controls.rationale: No carrier (the universe is not a subsystem with an external reference) and no readout (a global phase has no observable consequence); nothing to measure until a carrier and readout exist.

controls.name: Earth core mass fraction
controls.rationale: step0 PASS: carrier = Earth's inner and outer core within the whole Earth; readout = integrate seismologically constrained radial density profiles over the core and divide by independently measured total Earth mass. step1 PASS: dimensionless mass fraction, neither defined nor nominal; target has no drift with epoch, observer frame or time-slice because it is the frozen whole-planet mass partition left by completed accretion and bulk core-mantle differentiation, while later inner-core freezing only redistributes mass inside the carrier. step2 HISTORY: measured 0.325 ± 0.003 is a contingent output of that completed planetary process, not a static count or theorem. Public record: Wang, Lineweaver and Ireland, Icarus 299 (2018), arXiv:1708.08718, section 4.1.

controls.name: escape-to-circular speed ratio v_esc/v_circ at fixed radius
controls.rationale: Exactly sqrt(2) by Newtonian energy conservation for any inverse-square potential; a real, derived number already fixed by an established theory, so a second derivation would be redundant.
